headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: The latest ledger records fresh movement on the war’s chief contested fronts, though the action is uneven. Weathered Expanse remains the fiercest furnace, with 57 base events in 24 hours and seven in the latest two-hour watch; its holdings now stand at two Warden, two Colonial, and five neutral bases, while casualty and enlistment rates accelerate. Nevish Line reports 43 events, five in two hours, and has shifted to two Warden and six Colonial bases with no neutral positions. Stonecradle is also active, logging six events in two hours and fourteen in the day, with one Warden and eight Colonial bases. Linn Mercy’s ledger shows 34 events, including three within six hours, amid sharply rising losses, while its position remains two Warden, eight Colonial, and one neutral. Mooring County has seen 23 events, three within six hours, but Wardens still hold eleven of twelve bases. Marban Hollow remains divided at four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base; its sixteen events are older, with no movement in the latest six-hour watch. Most other sectors remain quiet by the base ledger.
